name: Quicken / opponent-response-before-destroy-and-grant
notes: An existing Quicken triggers when Wounding Blow red is played. Before the trigger resolves, the opponent may play Sigil of Solace blue: Stack3 and Quicken remains; attack has no grant. Sigil resolves first and heals20 to21, while token and grant remain unchanged. Only Quicken trigger resolution destroys token and grants go again; attack deals4, opponent17 and AP1 after resolution. This proves an actual response window rather than eager destruction/grant.
